Remaining: dolphin, whale, lion, tiger, elephant, gorilla.

I want a question that splits these as evenly as possible. "Lives in the ocean?" gives 2 vs 4 (dolphin and whale vs the rest). "Mostly eats other animals?" gives dolphin, whale (the whale is debatable), lion and tiger. "In the cat family?" gives 2 vs 4.

"Lives on the African savanna?" gives lion, elephant (and maybe gorilla, though gorillas live in forests), so it is ambiguous. "Mostly eats other animals?" is ambiguous too, since a whale may or may not count as a predator.

I'll go with the ocean question, which is clean: 2 vs 4.
